scope: Registered cash sources, server-generated cash payment voucher, atomic merchant cash disbursement register and printed evidence
implemented: Finance approver registers or deactivates cashboxes with custodian, location, version, reason and immutable before/after events
Cash execution accepts only an active registered cashbox; client cash receipt/source text rejected
Server voucher stable for payout, frozen source snapshot and unique reference saved atomically with execution
One cash register row follows receipt, review, final reconciliation or proven non-payment without duplicate cash-out
Staff-only paginated register and CSV for loaded merchant disbursements; explicitly not a whole cashbox balance
Printed voucher includes source, custodian, execution actor/time, statement, payout and beneficiary
No platform wallet funding prerequisite introduced; Zain Cash external transfer proof remains required

validation.actualTransactionPermissionSimulation: 11/11 allowed; all writes blocked in diagnostic

limitations: Register covers merchant payout cash movements; no claim of full physical cashbox balance or opening/receipts/transfers inventory
next: User registers test cashbox through new finance UI, selects it for current payout, confirms test handover, then owner receipt and staff reconciliation before financial case closure.
